title: Riders of a built train each count as a lane
what: In lanes_state, a branch already merged into another open branch (a train rider) is not a lane of its own; the train is one lane.
why: 28 Oct ~07:40 UTC: `relay queue start` refused three top fixes with 'no free lane: 6 of 6 running' while only one change was being built (bench-tools at its landing gate); train-24 and its three riders (precheck-tests, gate-rerun, recheck-take, all closed on their branches and merged into wt/train-24) counted as four lanes, picks and spec-met waited (one for the paid run, one for bench-tools). Lanes stood idle for the length of a paid run (28-110 min).
failing_case: Branches wt/a, wt/b merged into wt/train-1, all three open, setting 2: lanes_state says 3 of 2 running and start refuses.
pass_cases: The same: 1 of 2 running, one item can start.
A rider not yet merged into the train still counts as its own lane.
